**Expected and actual behavior**

**Minimal reproduction**
Include the command, sanitized configuration and response status. Do not include
credentials, private prompts, private paths or model weights.

**Versions**
Project commit/tag, Python, operating system, backend version and model identifier.

**Evidence**
Relevant test output or sanitized metrics. Distinguish fixture, installed-client,
and real-model results.
